name: validate_profile
description: Validate a Dynamic Profiles JSON document by parsing it with nucore's own profile loader. Accepts either shape: the flat wire shape (editors/nodedefs/linkdefs at the top level -- the same document polyglot.getJsonProfile()/updateJsonProfile() use, and what generate_plugin_scaffold's own profile argument is) or the catalog shape (families -> instances -> nodedefs/editors/linkdefs). Returns any structural problems found (missing ids, dangling editor references, malformed properties/commands, a nodedef missing its links object or name, an editor with a misplaced names mapping or non-string uom, a links.ctl/links.rsp reference to an undefined linkdef, or a cmd:true linkdef that also specifies parameters) so they can be fixed before installing the plugin. Does not touch the hub -- purely local validation. Call this any time a candidate profile is shared or generated, not just when something looks wrong.

profile.description: The raw Dynamic Profiles JSON document to validate -- either the wire shape (as returned by/sent to polyglot.getJsonProfile()/updateJsonProfile()) or the catalog shape (families/instances).
